notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total Governmental Funds column (pp6-7); business-type from the proprietary funds statement Total Enterprise Funds column (p11; Internal Service Fund excluded). Business-type 'Miscellaneous' operating revenue recorded as charges for services because the Statement of Activities (p3) counts total operating revenues (incl. internal service 780,904) in Charges for Services (24,710,037). Capital outlay on the statement has no function printed (General Fund and ARPA lines labelled 'Capital Outlay'; Street Fund column -> Streets/Highways). ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet 'Cash and cash equivalents' 3,652,199 (p5); also cash with county treasurer 70,218 and restricted cash 3,115,785; beginning cash not printed. The only supplementary schedule (pp14-15 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All-Purpose Fund) combines governmental and business-type funds on a budgetary basis, so detail is per fund column of the governmental funds statement and the proprietary funds statement (per-fund detail rule); the budget schedule is not recorded. Enterprise expenditure totals for Electric, Water and Sewer cite the Statement of Activities expense column (p3), which equals operating expenses + interest expense. Sewer proceeds from long-term debt 4,265,214 appear only in the cash flow statement (p12). Government-wide business-type net position 31,516,951 includes the internal service fund (233,479). Identity: 7,273,137 + 14,041,722 - 15,148,457 + 2,605,043 - 2,607,411 = 6,164,034; business-type 29,597,155 + 23,958,451 - 22,274,502 + 2,368 = 31,283,472. Read pages 1-15 of 15
